source: you-search tool, from tools/list on https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free

verified.country: live: tests/providers/test_you_mcp.py::test_live_inline_operators_are_taken_out_of_the_query (accepted and stripped; its effect on results is not yet shown)
verified.locale: live: tests/providers/test_you_mcp.py::test_live_inline_operators_are_taken_out_of_the_query (accepted and stripped; its effect on results is not yet shown)
verified.recency: live: tests/test_integration_surface.py::test_recency_keeps_dated_results_near_the_window (freshness: if the query names a timeframe, the broader of the two wins)

safesearch.note: off | moderate | strict; unset, the API's moderate applies.

knowledge.note: core, the only mode and the default; knowledge results stay in raw.

extraction_source.note: cache | fetch | blend; full_page extraction only.

include_domains.note: Not an argument of you-search; the shared include_domains is sent as inline site: operators in the query, which the tool maps to it and strips (seen keyless on 2026-11-09, two sites both kept). It cannot be combined with exclude_domains, so the pair is refused.

boost_domains.note: Host-only: set under params._meta or an X-Search-* header, which provider_options cannot reach.

country.note: Not an argument of you-search; the shared country is sent as an inline loc: operator. The tool strips any loc: value, unknown ones too (loc:ZZ answered normally), so the REST API's 36 codes are enforced before the call.

language.note: Not an argument of you-search; the shared locale is sent as an inline lang: operator with the REST API's tag (lang:PT-BR was stripped and answered). Values off the REST list are refused before the call.
